name: Barbell Hang Clean
steps: Stand holding a barbell outside your thighs with a flat back and hinge to lower the bar above your knees.
Drive explosively through your legs and hips to accelerate the bar upward close to your body.
Move under the bar into a front squat and turn your elbows forward to receive it across your shoulders.
Stand tall to finish the lift, then lower the bar smoothly back to your thighs under control.
tips: Finish extending your hips and legs before bending your elbows to pull under the bar.
Receive the bar with high elbows so it rests securely on your shoulders rather than straining your wrists.
